description: Checks the 6-digit code the user received after submit_email. On success returns a leadToken: pass it as lead_token to Hire Overseas tools that ask for it for the rest of the conversation. Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow 5 attempts.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the email, as the user typed it, e.g. '482913'

email.description: The same email given to submit_email

name: verify_email
title: Confirm the user's email with their code
